# Hickory Grove Christian School — Summer Programs (Camp Catalog)

- **School:** Hickory Grove Christian School (HGCS), 7200 E. WT Harris Blvd., Charlotte, NC
 28215. A ministry of Hickory Grove Baptist Church.
 live `academics/summer-camps` page shows only eight bare session-date windows and pushes
 all camp names, descriptions, grades and prices behind the **Brushfire** registration
 platform (`brushfire.com/hgchristian`), which requires drilling into each individual
 event and is not crawlable. The full named catalog below is therefore **recovered from
 2022–2023 Internet Archive (Wayback Machine) snapshots**, which captured the pages while
 the camps were still listed inline. All camp names, dates, hours, grade bands and
 instructor names are transcribed **char-for-char from those snapshots**.
- **IMPORTANT — HISTORICAL / REPRESENTATIVE, not a current live list.** This catalog
 reflects the **Summer 2023** offering (with Summer 2022 athletic variants noted). HGCS
 runs a summer-camp program every year, but the specific 2026 camp names/dates are hidden
 behind Brushfire and were not publicly recoverable. Treat this file as the
 representative shape of HGCS summer programming, not a guarantee of the exact 2026 slate.
- **Prices:** **NOT PUBLISHED.** No per-camp price is shown on any Wayback snapshot or on
 the live pages; pricing exists only inside the Brushfire checkout flow. → the Cost
 Planner card should be **OMITTED** for this school.
- **Summer wrap-around care:** **NONE.** HGCS's Before/After-School program explicitly
 runs the school year only and is "closed... during the summer." No summer before-care,
 after-care or full-day wrap-around option exists. Camps are half-day only.

Registration is per-camp through the school's registration platform (in 2023, individual
"[camp] registration" links; in 2026, the Brushfire portal at `brushfire.com/hgchristian`).
Athletic camps additionally require the **Atrium Health Release Form**, provided at
registration. Several 2026 sessions already show "sold out" / "full" on the live page.

sections.text:
- **NOT PUBLISHED:** any per-camp price (all pricing is inside the Brushfire checkout) →
 **omit the Cost Planner card**. Registration fee, deposits, sibling/early-bird discounts
 are likewise not published.
- **NO summer wrap-around care:** the before/after-school program is a school-year program,
 "closed... during the summer" (L4). Camps are half-day (ending 12:00 or 1:00 pm) with no
 extended-day/lunch-hour add-on published.
- **HISTORICAL / REPRESENTATIVE catalog:** camp list is the Summer 2023 slate recovered
 from Wayback (with 2022 athletic variants), because the live 2026 catalog is hidden
 behind Brushfire. The exact 2026 camp names were not publicly recoverable, though the
 live page confirms **8 session windows** consistent with the ~8 week-blocks below.
- **Duplicate camp runs are intentional:** Science Camp and Foundational Fluency Camp each
 ran in two separate week-blocks; both instances are listed verbatim above.
